en.q: Which of the following are given in the AML/CFT Guideline as examples of the product, service or transaction risk factors that an MSO should consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
statements: The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the business that is carried on by the MSO
The characteristics of the products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
Whether the volume and size of the MSO's transactions are in line with its usual activity and the profile of its customers
Whether the products or services offered by the MSO may inherently favour anonymity
notes: True: ¶2.4(c)(i) states “the nature, scale, diversity and complexity of its business”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(ii) states “the characteristics of products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(iii) states “whether the volume and size of its transactions are in line with the usual activity of the MSO and the profile of its customers”.
True: ¶2.4(c)(v) states “whether the products or services that may inherently favour anonymity”.

en.q: Which statements about appropriate certifiers and certification of identity documents under the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: A certifier who signs and dates a copy and states their capacity may omit the statement that it is a true copy of the original.
MSOs may accept copies from a legal person customer’s internal professional who is bound by a relevant professional body’s conduct rules and certifies in a professional capacity.
A member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction is included among the examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
A Justice of the Peace is included among the non-exhaustive examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
The Guideline expressly lists certified public accountants, lawyers, notaries public and chartered secretaries among its examples of appropriate professional certifiers.
notes: False: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶9 states “The certifier should state that it is a true copy of the original (or words to similar effect)”. Signing and dating do not replace the required true-copy statement.

True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A footnote 74 states “an MSO may accept the copy documents certified by a professional person within a legal person customer if that professional person is subject to the professional conduct requirements of a relevant professional body, and has certified the copy documents in his or her professional capacity”.
True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶8(b) states “a member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction”.
True: AML/CFT Guideline App.A ¶8(d) states “a Justice of the Peace; and (e) other professional person”.

True: Appendix A ¶8(e) lists other professional persons such as certified public accountants, lawyers, notaries public and chartered secretaries. The examples are non-exhaustive; the paragraph is not a claim that company directors can never otherwise qualify.

statements: 證明人在複本上簽署、寫上日期及註明身分後，便可省略說明該文件為正本的真確複本。
法人客戶內的專業人士如須遵守相關專業團體的操守規定，並以專業身分認證，經營者可接納有關文件複本。
在對等司法管轄區的司法人員，屬指引列出的認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之一。
太平紳士亦列於認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之中，而該名單並非詳盡無遺。
指引明列的合適專業證明人例子包括會計師、律師、公證人及特許秘書，可認證身分核實文件。
notes: 不正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》附錄A第9段列明「證明人必須說明該複本文件為正本文件的真確複本(或具類似效力的字詞)」。簽署及寫上日期不能取代說明文件為真確複本的要求。

en.q: Which statements correctly describe the Guideline’s listed factors for an MSO’s assessment of jurisdictional equivalence?
statements: The factors include whether the jurisdiction is a member of FATF-style regional bodies and the recent mutual evaluation report published by those bodies.
The factors include whether the FATF identifies the jurisdiction as having strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and its recent progress in improving its AML/CFT regime.
The advisory circulars named in the factors are those the JFIU issues to alert MSOs to jurisdictions with poor AML/CFT controls.
The factors include other AML/CFT-related publications issued by specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations.
notes: Correct: ¶4.16.2(a) lists membership of “FATF-style regional bodies” and the “recent mutual evaluation report” published by those bodies.
Correct: ¶4.16.2(b) includes both the FATF’s identification of strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and “the recent progress of improving its AML/CFT regime”.
False: ¶4.16.2(c) names advisory circulars “issued by the CCE”, not the JFIU. This substitutes the issuing body in that listed factor.
Correct: ¶4.16.2(d) lists other AML/CFT-related publications by “specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations”.

tc.q: 以下哪些陳述正確描述《打擊洗錢指引》列出的司法管轄區對等評估考慮因素？
statements: 考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否屬於與財務行動特別組織相類似職能的地區組織的成員，以及這些地區組織發表的相互評估報告。
考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否被財務行動特別組織識別為缺乏執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略，以及近期改善制度的進度。
考慮因素列出的忠告通函，是聯合財富情報組發出、提醒金錢服務經營者哪些司法管轄區在管控打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面表現欠佳的通函。
考慮因素包括專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構所發布、關於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的其他刊物。
notes: 正確：第4.16.2(a)段列明與特別組織相類似職能的地區組織的成員資格，以及這些地區組織發表的相互評估報告。
正確：第4.16.2(b)段包括特別組織識別的策略不足，以及「近期改善打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的進度」。
錯誤：第4.16.2(c)段列明「任何由關長不時發出的忠告通函」，發出者是關長，並非聯合財富情報組。
正確：第4.16.2(d)段列明「專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構」發布的相關其他刊物。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline's summary of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (OSCO) and the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance (DTROP), which of the following are correct?
statements: The OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to issue restraint orders and charging orders over the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO.
Under the OSCO, the Courts are given jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes, among other matters.
One of the offences that the OSCO creates is an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences.
Assets that are suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities may be investigated under provisions that the DTROP contains.
notes: Correct: ¶1.20(b) — the OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to issue restraint orders and charging orders in relation to the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO.
Correct: ¶1.20(b) — the OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes.
Correct: ¶1.20(c) — the OSCO, among other things, creates an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences.
Correct: ¶1.19 — the DTROP contains provisions for the investigation of assets that are suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities.

en.q: Which statements correctly identify the authorities responsible for terrorist designation, sanctions regulations and unfreezing terrorist property?
statements: A committee of the UNSC established under relevant UNSC resolutions can designate a person as a terrorist or terrorist associate.
Under the UNATMO, the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of Appeal for an order specifying a person as a terrorist or terrorist associate.
The UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations implementing sanctions decided by the UNSC, including targeted financial sanctions.
The Secretary for Justice can license an exception under the UNATMO that allows property already frozen under its prohibitions to be unfrozen.
notes: True: AML/CFT Guideline ¶6.4 states “Where a person or property is designated by a Committee of the UNSC established pursuant to the relevant UNSCRs as stated in paragraph [6.2] as a terrorist/terrorist associate or terrorist property”.

False: AML/CFT Guideline ¶6.4 states “the Chief Executive may make an application to the Court of First Instance for an order to specify a person or property as a terrorist/terrorist associate or terrorist property respectively”. The application is to the Court of First Instance, which may make the designation order.
True: AML/CFT Guideline ¶6.7 states “The UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UNSC, including targeted financial sanctions”.
False: AML/CFT Guideline ¶6.6 states “The S for S can licence exceptions to the prohibitions to enable frozen property to be unfrozen”. The licensing power belongs to the Secretary for Security.

tc.q: 以下有關恐怖分子指定、制裁規例及恐怖分子財產解凍的主管機關，哪些陳述正確？
statements: 根據相關聯合國安理會決議成立的聯合國安理會委員會，可指定某人為恐怖分子或與恐怖分子有聯繫者。
根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，行政長官可向上訴法庭申請命令，指明某人為恐怖分子或與恐怖分子有聯繫者。
《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，執行聯合國安全理事會所決定的制裁，包括針對性金融制裁。
律政司司長可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》就禁令批予特許，准許將已遭凍結的財產解凍。
notes: 正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第6.4段列明「凡某人或財產如第[6.2]段所述被根據相關的聯合國安理會決議成立的聯合國安理會委員會分別指定為恐怖分子／與恐怖分子有聯繫者或恐怖分子財產」。
不正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第6.4段列明「行政長官可向原訟法庭提出申請，要求作出命令分別指明某人或財產為恐怖分子／與恐怖分子有聯繫者或恐怖分子財產」。行政長官須向原訟法庭申請，由原訟法庭作出指定命令。
正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第6.7段列明「《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以執行聯合國安全理事會所決定的制裁，包括對例如聯合國安全理事會或其委員會指認的若干人士及實體實施針對性金融制裁」。
不正確：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第6.6段列明「保安局局長可就禁令批予特許，准許將已凍結的財產解凍」。批予解凍特許的權力屬保安局局長。

en.q: According to the C&ED's circular on the FATF's public consultation on guidance to increase payment transparency, which of the following are correct?
statements: The FATF agreed in June 2025 to revise Recommendation 16 so that it keeps pace with changes in the payment landscape.
The revisions increase the transparency of information accompanying cross-border payments and require tools to protect against fraud and error.
The end of 2028 is the date by which all jurisdictions around the world are expected to be ready to implement the changes.
Feedback is invited on whether the guidance gives sufficient clarity on how Recommendation 16 applies to digital wallets and mobile money.
The consultation invites views on whether the guidance sufficiently explains implementing Recommendation 16 while meeting data protection and privacy requirements.
notes: Correct: paragraph 2 of the circular — the revisions to FATF's Recommendation 16, agreed in June 2025, will keep pace with changes in the payment landscape.

Correct: paragraph 2 — the revisions strengthen the safety and security of the international payment system by increasing transparency of information that accompanies cross-border payments and requiring the introduction of tools to protect against fraud and error.
Incorrect: paragraph 2 — all jurisdictions around the world are expected to be ready to implement the changes by the end of 2030, not 2028.

Correct: paragraph 3 — feedback is invited on issues including whether the guidance provides sufficient clarity and support on how Recommendation 16 applies to newer payment methods, such as digital wallets and mobile money.
Correct: paragraph 3 includes implementing Recommendation 16 and meeting data protection and privacy requirements together among the issues on which feedback is invited.

tc.q: 根據海關有關財務行動特別組織就加強支付透明度的指引展開公眾諮詢的通函，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: FATF在2025年6月通過修訂第16項建議，使該建議與支付格局的變化同步。
第16項建議的修訂將提升跨境支付資訊的透明度，並要求引入防止詐騙及錯誤的工具。
全球各司法區預計需在2028年底前，完成實施經修訂的第16項建議所帶來的相關變更。
FATF邀請的意見範圍包括指引是否清晰說明第16項建議如何適用於電子錢包與移動支付等新興支付方式。
諮詢邀請各界就指引是否充分說明如何落實第16項建議，並同時符合資料保護及隱私要求，提出意見。
notes: 正確：通函第2段——FATF於2025年6月通過的第16項建議的修訂，將與支付格局的變化同步。
正確：通函第2段——有關修訂透過提升跨境支付資訊的透明度，及要求引入防止詐騙及錯誤的工具，以增強國際支付系統的安全及穩定。
不正確：通函第2段——所有的司法區預計需於2030年底前實施相關的變更，並非2028年底前。
正確：通函第3段——FATF邀請的意見範圍包括該指引是否就第16項建議如何適用於新興支付方式（如電子錢包與移動支付）提供足夠的清晰度與支援。
正確：第3段把落實第16項建議並同時符合資料保護及隱私要求，列為邀請意見的議題。

en.q: Regarding the fees the AMLO specifies for applications by money service operators and for copies of entries in the register of licensees, which of the following are correct?
statements: An application for the grant of a licence carries a fee of $3,810, with $2,440 added for each additional business premises.
A renewal application carries the same basic fee as a grant application, $3,810, plus $410 for each additional business premises.
An application for the grant of a licence also carries $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
An application for approval to become a licensee's director carries a fee of $945 for each application that is made.
For each person in relation to whom approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner or partner is sought, the fee is $945.
An uncertified copy of an entry in the register of licensees costs $160 per copy, the same as a certified copy.
notes: Correct: item 4 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an application for the grant of a licence at $3,810, plus $2,440 for each additional business premises.

Incorrect: item 5 of Schedule 3 sets the basic fee for an application for the renewal of a licence at $910, not the $3,810 that item 4 sets for a grant; $410 is then added for each additional business premises.
Correct: item 4 of Schedule 3 adds, to the fee for an application for the grant of a licence, $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
Incorrect: item 6 of Schedule 3 charges $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made, not $945 for each application.
Correct: items 7 and 8 of Schedule 3 charge $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made, for approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner and to become a licensee's partner.

Incorrect: item 2 of Schedule 3 charges $1.5 per page or portion of a page for an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register; $160 per copy is the fee in item 1 for certifying a copy.

en.q: Regarding the offences under the AMLO for contravening a specified provision of Schedule 2, which of the following are correct?
statements: A financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
A financial institution that, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision is liable on summary conviction to a $500,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment.
A person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution, causes it to contravene a specified provision commits an offence.
An employee charged with causing the institution, with intent to defraud, to contravene a specified provision has a defence if he or she proves following its compliance policies and procedures.
A fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence of contravening a specified provision is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.
notes: Correct: section 5(5)(a) makes a financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
Incorrect: section 5(6)(b) provides for a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on summary conviction, not 6 months.

Correct: section 5(8) covers a person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution or any relevant authority, causes or permits it to contravene a specified provision.

Incorrect: section 5(9) gives this defence only in proceedings for an offence under section 5(7), knowingly causing or permitting a contravention; it does not extend to the offence of doing so with intent to defraud under section 5(8).
Correct: section 5(10) provides that a fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence under the section is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂違反附表2指明的條文的罪行，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
金融機構出於詐騙任何有關當局的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁6個月。
關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該機構的意圖而致使該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪。
僱員被控出於詐騙意圖而致使金融機構違反指明的條文，如證明其作為是按照該機構為確保遵從而設立的政策及程序，即可作免責辯護。
如合夥因被裁定干犯違反指明的條文的罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。
notes: 正確：第5(5)(a)條訂明，金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
不正確：第5(6)(b)條訂明，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁1年，並非6個月。
正確：第5(8)條涵蓋關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該金融機構或任何有關當局的意圖，而致使或准許該機構違反指明的條文。
不正確：第5(9)條所訂的免責辯護只適用於就第5(7)條（明知而致使或准許違反）所訂罪行提起的法律程序，並不適用於第5(8)條出於詐騙意圖的罪行。
正確：第5(10)條訂明，如合夥因被裁定干犯該條所訂罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。

If a financial institution, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision, the financial institution commits an offence and is liable— (a) on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 7 years; or (b) on summary conviction to a fine of $500,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year

is concerned in the management of a financial institution, with intent to defraud the financial institution or any relevant authority, causes or permits the financial institution to contravene a specified provision

In any proceedings for an offence under subsection (7) against a person who is an employee of a financial institution or is employed to work for a financial institution, it is a defence for the person to prove

en.q: Regarding the offences for non-compliance with requirements imposed by an authorized person in a routine inspection, which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on summary conviction, by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
Failing to comply with the requirement with intent to defraud is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years.
Knowingly giving an answer false in a material particular, in purported compliance, is punishable on conviction on indictment by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.
An employee of the person on whom the requirement is imposed commits an offence if, with intent to defraud, the employee causes or allows that person to fail to comply.
notes: Correct: section 10(1) and (2)(a) make a person who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9(3), (5), (9) or (10) liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $200,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year.
Correct: section 10(2)(b) provides, for that offence, a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction.

Correct: section 10(5) and (9)(a) make a person who, with intent to defraud, fails to comply with the requirement liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 7 years.

Correct: section 10(3) and (4)(a) cover a person who knowingly or recklessly gives an answer false or misleading in a material particular in purported compliance, and set a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on indictment.

Correct: section 10(7) makes it an offence for a related person, defined in section 10(11) to include an employee, to cause or allow the obligated person, with intent to defraud, to fail to comply with the requirement.

tc.q: 關於不遵從獲授權人在例行視察中施加的要求的罪行，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。
無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
出於詐騙意圖而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
明知而以在要項上屬虛假的回答充作遵從，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
被施加該要求的人的僱員，如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許該人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。
notes: 正確：第10(1)及(2)(a)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從根據第9(3)、(5)、(9)或(10)條施加的要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。
正確：第10(2)(b)條訂明，就該罪行一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
正確：第10(5)及(9)(a)條訂明，任何人出於詐騙意圖而沒有遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
正確：第10(3)及(4)(a)條涵蓋任何人明知或罔顧而給予在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的回答，充作遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
正確：第10(7)條訂明，義務人的相關人士（第10(11)條界定為包括其僱員）如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許義務人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。

en.q: Under the Disciplinary Fining Guideline, which statements about setting a pecuniary penalty and assessing a contravention are correct?
statements: Although three times the profit gained or costs avoided is one alternative maximum, the CCE does not automatically link the actual fine to that profit or saving.
In assessing conduct after a contravention, the CCE considers whether the MSO attempted to conceal it; the factor is not confined to successful concealment.
After a contravention or possible contravention is identified, the CCE considers remedial steps, action against those involved, and steps to prevent similar breaches.
For the same incident, the CCE takes account of other relevant authorities’ punishment and regulatory action, including action likely to be taken but not yet taken.
notes: Correct: ¶6 distinguishes the alternative statutory maximum from the actual fine, which the CCE “will not automatically link” to profit gained or costs avoided.
Correct: ¶9(b)(i) asks whether the MSO “attempted to conceal” the contravention. A failed attempt is still an attempt.
Correct: ¶9(b)(ii) lists remediation, action against those involved and steps to ensure similar contraventions do not recur.
Correct: ¶9(c)(iii) includes punishment imposed and regulatory action “taken or likely to be taken” by other relevant authorities on the same incident.

tc.q: 根據《紀律處分罰款指引》，以下有關釐定罰款及評估違規行為的陳述，哪些正確？

en.q: Which of the following correctly describe terms used to identify customers and their business relationships?
statements: A legal person’s principal place of business is where it primarily operates or carries on its main activities, and may be the same as or different from its registered office address.
For the CDD requirements, the expression “pre-existing customer” covers a customer with whom the MSO established a business relationship before 1 April 2018.
A customer identification number uniquely identifies the originator to the originating institution and is the same number as the unique transaction reference number for a wire transfer.
A travel document is a passport or other document bearing the holder’s photograph and establishing the holder’s identity and nationality, domicile or place of permanent residence.
notes: True: FAQ Q5 defines the place by the legal person’s principal operations or activities, not by requiring a match with its registered office.
False: ¶4.12.1 fixes the boundary at “1 April 2012”, when the AMLO came into effect, not 1 April 2018.
False: ¶10.5 footnote 70 says it “is a different number from the unique transaction reference number”; identifying a customer differs from identifying a transaction.
True: Appendix A ¶3 requires a photograph and the specified identity and nationality or residence information; the definition is not limited to passports.

tc.q: 關於識別客戶及其業務關係所用的詞語，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 法人的主要營業地點是營運主要所在地或主要活動的地點，其地址可與註冊辦事處地址相同或不同。
就客戶盡職審查規定而言，先前客戶是指在2018年4月1日前，已與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的客戶。
客戶識別號碼是用作識別就發起機構而言屬匯款人的獨特號碼，並與電傳轉帳的獨特交易參考編號屬同一號碼。
旅遊證件是附有持有人照片，能確定其身分及國籍、原居地或永久居留地的護照或其他證件。
notes: 正確：常見問題第5問按法人的主要營運或活動界定主要營業地點，並說可與註冊辦事處地址「相同或不同」。
錯誤：第4.12.1段以打擊洗錢條例生效的「2012年4月1日」為界線，並非2018年4月1日。
錯誤：第10.5段附註70說客戶識別號碼與獨特交易參考編號「並不相同」；兩者並非同一號碼。
正確：附錄A第3段要求持有人照片，以及所列的身分及國籍或居留地資料；旅遊證件並不限於護照。

en.q: Regarding the local place for storage of books and records (LPS), which of the following are correct according to the Licensing Guide?
statements: Every applicant is required to have an LPS, including an applicant that will operate its money service at particular premises.
The LPS is a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records of the licensee's money service transactions.
The LPS must be under the licensee's control, so that C&ED officers have access to the books and records to perform their functions under the AMLO.
The CCE will not accept an MSO's residential premises, or the premises of a service provider such as its accounting firm, as the MSO's LPS.
The landlord's permission to use the LPS for money service business should be included in its tenancy agreement or in a letter from the landlord to the applicant.
A licence or renewal application that fails to submit the information of the LPS is deemed an invalid application, which C&ED will not process.
notes: Correct: ¶4.10 says that all applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records; the requirement is not confined to applicants without particular premises.
Correct: ¶4.11 describes the LPS as a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records in respect of its money service transactions.
Correct: ¶4.11 says the LPS must be under the control of the licensee so as to facilitate the C&ED officer's access to them to perform the functions under the AMLO.

Correct: ¶4.11 says residential address/premises of an MSO or the address/premises of its service provider, such as a company secretarial firm, accounting firm or solicitor firm, will not be accepted by the CCE as the LPS.

Correct: ¶4.11 says the landlord of the LPS must grant permission to the MSO to use the premises for money service business, which should be included in the tenancy agreement of the LPS or in a letter issued by the landlord to the applicant.
Correct: ¶4.11 says failure to submit the information of LPS for a licence application or renewal application is deemed as invalid application which will not be processed by C&ED.

snapshot.en: For in-person CDD with a natural person customer or someone establishing a relationship for a legal person, trust or similar arrangement, staff should generally sight the original ID document and keep a copy.
snapshot.tc: 自然人客戶或代表法人、信託或類似安排建立業務關係的人為盡職審查而現身時，通常可由職員查看識別文件正本，並保存複本。

coverage.point: 代表法人、信托或类似法律安排建立业务关系的人现身CDD时同受原件及留副本规则涵盖
coverage.dedup_note: Final authorized expansion expressly covers both categories of physically-present persons.

snapshot.en: For in-person CDD with a natural person customer or someone establishing a relationship for a legal person, trust or similar arrangement, staff should generally sight the original ID document and keep a copy.
snapshot.tc: 自然人客戶或代表法人、信託或類似安排建立業務關係的人為盡職審查而現身時，通常可由職員查看識別文件正本，並保存複本。

coverage.point: 查看识别文件正本后保存副本

snapshot.en: For in-person CDD with a natural person customer or someone establishing a relationship for a legal person, trust or similar arrangement, staff should generally sight the original ID document and keep a copy.
snapshot.tc: 自然人客戶或代表法人、信託或類似安排建立業務關係的人為盡職審查而現身時，通常可由職員查看識別文件正本，並保存複本。

coverage.point: 法人内部专业人员受操守规管且以专业身份认证的例外
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-387#2.

snapshot.en: MSOs may accept copies from a legal person customer’s internal professional who is bound by a relevant professional body’s conduct rules and certifies in a professional capacity.
snapshot.tc: 法人客戶內的專業人士如須遵守相關專業團體的操守規定，並以專業身分認證，經營者可接納有關文件複本。

coverage.point: 证明确认真确副本的声明
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-387#1.

snapshot.en: A certifier who signs and dates a copy and states their capacity may omit the statement that it is a true copy of the original.
snapshot.tc: 證明人在複本上簽署、寫上日期及註明身分後，便可省略說明該文件為正本的真確複本。

coverage.point: 认证文件真确性有疑问须额外措施

snapshot.en: If the MSO doubts the authenticity of certified documents or whether they relate to the customer, it should take additional measures to mitigate ML/TF risk.
snapshot.tc: 認證文件真確性或與客戶的關係存疑時，應採取額外措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

coverage.point: 文件是否与客户有关有疑问须额外措施

snapshot.en: If the MSO doubts the authenticity of certified documents or whether they relate to the customer, it should take additional measures to mitigate ML/TF risk.
snapshot.tc: 認證文件真確性或與客戶的關係存疑時，應採取額外措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

coverage.point: 对等司法人员、太平绅士及专业证明确认人
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-387#3–5; other examples remain m6-353#3 (consular officer) and statutory intermediaries.

snapshot.en: A member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction is included among the examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區的司法人員，屬指引列出的認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之一。

snapshot.en: A Justice of the Peace is included among the non-exhaustive examples of appropriate persons to certify identity documents.
snapshot.tc: 太平紳士亦列於認證身分核實文件的合適人選例子之中，而該名單並非詳盡無遺。

snapshot.en: The Guideline expressly lists certified public accountants, lawyers, notaries public and chartered secretaries among its examples of appropriate professional certifiers.
snapshot.tc: 指引明列的合適專業證明人例子包括會計師、律師、公證人及特許秘書，可認證身分核實文件。

coverage.point: 毋须认证所有其他CDD资料及文件

snapshot.en: Alongside official documents used to verify identity, the MSO is expected to require certification of every other item of CDD information or documentation supplied by the customer.
snapshot.tc: 除用於核實身分的官方文件外，金錢服務經營者亦須要求客戶提供的每一項其他客戶盡職審查資料或文件均經認證。

coverage.point: 可对照公开来源查证文件时毋须认证

snapshot.en: Certification is not required where the MSO is able to check the customer’s documents against public sources; this is an express exception to the general certification expectation.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如能將客戶的文件與公開來源核對，便無須認證該等文件；這是一般認證要求的一項明確例外。

coverage.point: 有意出示文件正本的客户获提供机会
coverage.dedup_note: EN always provided opportunity; TC 应尽量容许, no false point based on difference.

snapshot.en: As a general principle, customers should always be given the opportunity, if they wish, to present their original documents to the MSO’s staff for the identification process.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，金錢服務經營者應盡量容許有意出示正本的客戶，向該經營者的職員出示文件正本，以供身分識別程序使用。

coverage.point: 定期覆核取得证据确认持票人股份认可／注册保管人
coverage.dedup_note: m6-361#4 tests initial independent confirmation actor, not ongoing review.

snapshot.en: As part of its ongoing periodic review, an MSO should obtain evidence confirming the authorised or registered custodian where its customer’s bearer shares are held by such a custodian.
snapshot.tc: 客戶的持票人股份由認可或註冊保管人保管時，金錢服務經營者應取得證據確定該保管人，作為持續定期覆核的一部分。

coverage.point: 股份不存放保管人时须要求客户即时通知拥有权变动
coverage.dedup_note: m6-361#5 tests annual beneficial-owner declarations, not immediate change notification.

snapshot.en: Where bearer shares are not deposited with an authorised or registered custodian, the MSO should require its customer to notify ownership changes at the next annual declaration.
snapshot.tc: 持票人股份如非存放於認可或註冊保管人，金錢服務經營者應要求客戶在下一次年度聲明時，知會股份擁有權的變動。

coverage.point: 高风险客户亦不一律以相同方式使用相同财富来源程序

snapshot.en: For high risk customers, the MSO is expected to apply the same source of wealth procedures to all such customers in the same manner, regardless of differences in their circumstances.
snapshot.tc: 對所有高風險客戶，金錢服務經營者均須以完全相同的方式應用相同財富來源程序，不論各人的情況有何差異。

coverage.point: 风险不足以支持时毋须数十年前财富来源证据

snapshot.en: For high risk customers, there is no expectation to collect source of wealth evidence dating back decades when the risk does not justify doing so, as this is often impractical.
snapshot.tc: 對高風險客戶，如風險水平不足以支持收集數十年前的財富來源證據，便無須收集，因為此舉通常並不切實可行。

coverage.point: 非高风险客户职业／业务性质通常足以理解基本状况

snapshot.en: For non-high risk customers, information used to understand the relationship’s purpose and nature, such as occupation or corporate business nature, should often suffice for a basic customer profile.
snapshot.tc: 對非高風險客戶，為了解業務關係的目的及性質而取得的職業或公司業務性質等資料，一般足以對客戶狀況有基本了解。

coverage.point: 基本状况用以监察结余、交易金额及交易量是否符合预期财富及状况
coverage.dedup_note: Additional directly related operative detail, not copied from an existing general risk-profile rule.

snapshot.en: For non-high risk customers, that basic profile should enable the MSO to monitor whether the account balance and transaction value and volume accord with the customer’s expected wealth and profile.
snapshot.tc: 對非高風險客戶，基本狀況資料應使金錢服務經營者能監察戶口結餘及交易金額和交易量，是否與客戶的預期財富及狀況一致。

coverage.point: 司法管辖区对等评估记录在案

snapshot.en: When evaluating whether jurisdictions other than FATF members apply requirements similar to Schedule 2 for equivalence purposes, the MSO should document its assessment of each jurisdiction.
snapshot.tc: 就對等目的評估特別組織成員以外的司法管轄區是否施加類似附表2的規定時，金錢服務經營者應將其對該司法管轄區的評估記錄在案。

coverage.point: 相类似职能地区组织成员及其相互评估报告
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-385#1; original gap ledger omitted this direct coverage.

snapshot.en: The factors include whether the jurisdiction is a member of FATF-style regional bodies and the recent mutual evaluation report published by those bodies.
snapshot.tc: 考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否屬於與財務行動特別組織相類似職能的地區組織的成員，以及這些地區組織發表的相互評估報告。

coverage.point: FATF策略不足及近期改善制度进度
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-385#2.

snapshot.en: The factors include whether the FATF identifies the jurisdiction as having strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and its recent progress in improving its AML/CFT regime.
snapshot.tc: 考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否被財務行動特別組織識別為缺乏執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略，以及近期改善制度的進度。

coverage.point: 关长提示管控不佳司法管辖区的忠告通函
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-385#3.

snapshot.en: The advisory circulars named in the factors are those the JFIU issues to alert MSOs to jurisdictions with poor AML/CFT controls.
snapshot.tc: 考慮因素列出的忠告通函，是聯合財富情報組發出、提醒金錢服務經營者哪些司法管轄區在管控打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面表現欠佳的通函。

coverage.point: 专门国家、国际、非政府或商业机构相关出版物
coverage.dedup_note: Unchanged m6-385#4.

snapshot.en: The factors include other AML/CFT-related publications issued by specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations.
snapshot.tc: 考慮因素包括專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構所發布、關於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的其他刊物。

coverage.point: 保密号码户口CDD纪录向关长、主管当局、CO、核数师及其他获授权人员开放
coverage.dedup_note: m7-166#5 covers prompt availability to external authorities/auditors under ¶8.2(b); this adds internal CO/authorized staff and numbered-account context.

snapshot.en: Even for numbered accounts, CDD records must be available to the CCE, other competent authorities, the compliance officer, auditors and other staff with appropriate authority.
snapshot.tc: 即使涉及保密號碼戶口，客戶盡職審查紀錄亦必須提供予關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、核數師及其他獲適當授權的人員。

coverage.point: 持续监察名单关联本身不自动强制EDD
coverage.dedup_note: Direct existing item from the roles/definitions round; no new semantic twin.

snapshot.en: A customer’s connection to a jurisdiction listed in the FATF statement on improving global AML/CFT compliance through the On-going Process does not make EDD mandatory.
snapshot.tc: 客戶與特別組織「持續進展」聲明所列司法管轄區有關連，並不令更嚴格盡職審查措施自動成為強制性規定。

coverage.point: 看似無關客戶採用相同交易模式，包括轉往同一人的帳戶，是可疑交易訊號。

snapshot.en: Seemingly unrelated customers sharing the same transaction pattern, such as transferring funds to one individual's account, is a listed red flag for third-party payments.
snapshot.tc: 多名看似沒有關連的客戶採用一樣的交易模式，例如將資金轉帳至同一名個人的帳戶，是第三方支付通函列出的可疑交易訊號。

coverage.point: 客戶不能應要求立即提供額外身分證明文件，屬警訊而非較低風險指標。

snapshot.en: A customer's inability to provide additional identification documents immediately when required is listed as an indication that the third-party payment presents relatively low risk.
snapshot.tc: 客戶不能應要求立即提供額外身分證明文件，通函把這種情況列作有關第三方支付具有相對較低風險的指標。

coverage.point: 客戶的聯繫公司是一般較低風險的第三方例子。

snapshot.en: The customer's affiliated companies and regulated financial institutions are examples of third parties generally considered to pose relatively low risks in the third-party payment circular.
snapshot.tc: 客戶的聯繫公司及受規管金融機構，是第三方支付通函列舉的一般可視為具有較低風險的第三方例子。

coverage.point: 受規管金融機構是一般較低風險的第三方例子。

snapshot.en: The customer's affiliated companies and regulated financial institutions are examples of third parties generally considered to pose relatively low risks in the third-party payment circular.
snapshot.tc: 客戶的聯繫公司及受規管金融機構，是第三方支付通函列舉的一般可視為具有較低風險的第三方例子。

coverage.point: 客戶支付前無法提供第三方付款人身分詳情作核實，須格外留神。

snapshot.en: Extra caution is called for if the customer cannot provide identity details of the third-party payer for verification before the payment is made.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶在進行支付前無法就第三方付款人的身分提供詳細資料作核實之用，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

coverage.point: 所有相關交易監察及調查職員須適時取得充分資料，以識別、分析及監察交易；已由原題直接測試。

snapshot.en: Transaction monitoring systems should give all relevant monitoring and investigation staff timely, sufficient information to identify, analyse and monitor transactions.
snapshot.tc: 交易監察系統及程序應向所有負責交易監察及調查的相關職員提供適時而充分的資料，足以識別、分析及有效監察客戶的交易。

coverage.point: 設定交易監察參數及門檻的因素包括付款／收款地點（英文為地理起點／終點）。

snapshot.en: In setting transaction-monitoring parameters and thresholds, the listed transaction characteristics include the geographical origin or destination of a payment or receipt handled for a customer.
snapshot.tc: 設計交易監察參數及門檻時，所列應顧及的交易特徵，包括金錢服務經營者為客戶處理的付款或收款的地點。

coverage.point: 正常戶口活動或營業額針對客戶，而非金錢服務經營者自身。

snapshot.en: In setting transaction-monitoring parameters and thresholds, the listed normal account activity or turnover is that of the MSO itself, rather than that of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 設計交易監察參數及門檻時，所列的正常戶口活動或營業額，指的是金錢服務經營者本身的活動或營業額，而非客戶的。

coverage.point: 由行政長官提出指定命令申請，受理法院是原訟法庭；原題主體判斷保留於替代題。

snapshot.en: Under the UNATMO, the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of Appeal for an order specifying a person as a terrorist or terrorist associate.
snapshot.tc: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，行政長官可向上訴法庭申請命令，指明某人為恐怖分子或與恐怖分子有聯繫者。

coverage.point: 指定命令可指明恐怖分子財產；法庭作出的命令亦會在憲報刊登。

snapshot.en: If the Court of First Instance makes an order specifying property as terrorist property under the UNATMO, that order will also be published in the Gazette.
snapshot.tc: 原訟法庭根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，作出指明某項財產為恐怖分子財產的命令後，該命令亦會在憲報刊登。

coverage.point: 提出上訴本身不會暫緩執行審裁處的裁定。

snapshot.en: Once an appeal against the Tribunal's determination is lodged under the AMLO, lodging it itself stays execution of that determination until the appeal is decided.
snapshot.tc: 一旦根據《打擊洗錢條例》針對審裁處的裁定提出上訴，提出上訴本身便會暫緩執行該裁定，直至上訴獲裁決。

coverage.point: 上訴提出後，覆核任何一方可另向上訴法庭申請暫緩執行；現有題直接考法院主體。

snapshot.en: Once an appeal against a Tribunal determination is lodged, the Court of First Instance may, on a review party’s application, stay that determination.
snapshot.tc: 針對審裁處裁定提出上訴後，原訟法庭可應覆核一方的申請，命令暫緩執行有關裁定。

coverage.point: 上訴許可可附加確使上訴得到公正、迅速及合乎經濟原則的處置而需要的條件。

snapshot.en: The Court of Appeal may grant leave subject to conditions it considers necessary to secure the just, expeditious and economical disposal of the appeal.
snapshot.tc: 上訴法庭可在其認為為確使上訴得到公正、迅速及合乎經濟原則的處置而需要的條件規限下，批予上訴許可。

coverage.point: 上訴許可須有合理機會得直，或其他有利於秉行公正的理由。

snapshot.en: Leave may be granted only if the Court of Appeal is satisfied that the appeal has a reasonable prospect of success or another interests-of-justice reason warrants hearing it.
snapshot.tc: 上訴法庭須信納上訴有合理機會得直，或有其他有利於秉行公正的理由因而應予審理，方可批予上訴許可。

coverage.point: 上訴法庭暫緩命令可附適當條件，包括訟費及繳存款項於審裁處。

snapshot.en: When ordering a stay after an appeal is lodged, the Court of Appeal may impose appropriate conditions, including costs and payment of money into the Tribunal.
snapshot.tc: 在上訴提出後命令暫緩執行時，上訴法庭可施加它認為適當的條件，包括關於訟費及繳存款項於審裁處的條件。

coverage.point: 續牌時每名須判定是否適當人選的人另繳$945，即使批給牌照時已繳費。

snapshot.en: Renewal also costs $945 for each person subject to the fit and proper person test, even if the fee was paid at the original grant.
snapshot.tc: 續牌亦須就每名須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945，即使發牌時已繳過有關費用。

coverage.point: 由無特定處所改為在特定處所經營，按每一營業處所收取$2,440。

snapshot.en: An MSO moving from no particular premises to particular premises pays $2,440 per business premises covered by its application.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人由無特定處所改為在特定處所經營金錢服務，其申請按每一營業處所收費$2,440。

coverage.point: 其他監管當局的適用範圍：它並非就該金錢服務經營者的有關當局。

snapshot.en: The special restrictions apply where the authority authorising the inspecting person, or appointing or directing the investigator, is not the relevant authority for the MSO concerned.
snapshot.tc: 如授權進行檢查的人，或委任或指示調查員的當局，並不是就有關金錢服務經營者的有關當局，便適用這些特別限制。

coverage.point: 檢查時索取客戶事務資料，其他監管當局須認為對檢查屬必要並藉書面證明。

snapshot.en: For routine inspection, the other authority's oral assurance that customer information is necessary for the inspection satisfies the required certification, without a written certificate of that opinion.
snapshot.tc: 在例行檢查中，其他監管當局口頭保證客戶資料對檢查屬必要，便符合所需的證明規定，無須藉書面證明它持有該意見。

coverage.point: 調查另須調查員有合理因由相信客戶可能提供與調查相關資料；證明書不能取代此條件。

snapshot.en: For investigation, the investigator must have reasonable cause to believe that the customer may be able to give relevant information; the other authority's necessity certificate alone is insufficient.
snapshot.tc: 在調查中，調查員須有合理因由相信客戶可能有能力提供與調查相關的資料；單憑其他監管當局的必要性證明並不足夠。

coverage.point: 調查時其他監管當局亦須認為披露或交出客戶資料對調查屬必要，並藉書面證明。

snapshot.en: For investigation, the other authority must also consider the customer-information disclosure or production necessary for that investigation and certify in writing that it holds that opinion.
snapshot.tc: 在調查中，其他監管當局亦須認為披露或交出有關客戶事務的資料或紀錄對調查屬必要，並藉書面證明它持有該意見。

coverage.point: 無合理辯解而不遵從視察或調查要求：公訴定罪為$200,000及1年；簡易定罪為第5級及6個月。共通規則只測一次。

snapshot.en: Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
snapshot.tc: 無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。

snapshot.en: Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on summary conviction, by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
snapshot.tc: 無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

coverage.point: 明知而以在要項上虛假的回答充作遵從視察或調查要求：公訴$1,000,000及2年；罔顧虛假調查回應：簡易第6級及6個月。

snapshot.en: Knowingly giving an answer false in a material particular, in purported compliance, is punishable on conviction on indictment by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.
snapshot.tc: 明知而以在要項上屬虛假的回答充作遵從，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。

snapshot.en: Recklessly giving a materially false response in purported compliance with an investigator's requirement is punishable on summary conviction by a level 6 fine and imprisonment for 6 months.
snapshot.tc: 罔顧回應是否在要項上屬虛假，仍以之充作遵從調查要求，循簡易程序定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

coverage.point: 出於詐騙意圖不遵從視察或調查要求：公訴定罪$1,000,000及7年。共通規則只測一次。

snapshot.en: Failing to comply with the requirement with intent to defraud is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years.
snapshot.tc: 出於詐騙意圖而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。

coverage.point: 出於詐騙意圖給予在要項上虛假的調查回答：簡易定罪第6級及6個月。

snapshot.en: With intent to defraud, giving a materially false answer in purported compliance with an investigation requirement carries a level 6 fine and six months' imprisonment on summary conviction.
snapshot.tc: 出於詐騙意圖，以在要項上虛假的回答充作遵從調查要求，循簡易程序定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

coverage.point: 義務人的僱員屬相關人士；出於詐騙意圖致使或容許義務人不遵從視察或調查要求，即屬犯罪。第13(14)條採用第10(11)條相同定義。

snapshot.en: An employee of the person on whom the requirement is imposed commits an offence if, with intent to defraud, the employee causes or allows that person to fail to comply.
snapshot.tc: 被施加該要求的人的僱員，如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許該人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。

coverage.point: 相關人士出於詐騙意圖容許義務人提供在要項上具誤導性的調查回答即屬犯罪，無須另獲財務利益。

snapshot.en: A related person who, with intent to defraud, allows the obligated person to give a materially misleading answer in purported compliance with an investigation requirement commits an offence only if financially benefited.
snapshot.tc: 相關人士出於詐騙意圖容許義務人以要項上具誤導性的回答充作遵從調查要求，須另獲財務利益才屬犯罪。

coverage.point: 同一行為已提起猶如藐視法庭罪般懲罰的程序而仍待決時，不得另提相關刑事程序。

snapshot.en: While proceedings to punish a person as if for contempt for the same conduct remain pending, criminal proceedings for non-compliance with an investigation requirement cannot be instituted against that person.
snapshot.tc: 就同一行為已提起的猶如藐視法庭罪般懲罰程序仍待決時，不得就不遵從調查要求另提刑事程序。

coverage.point: 金錢服務經營者出於詐騙關長的意圖違反指明條文，公訴定罪為$1,000,000及7年，非以調查罪的刑罰代替。

snapshot.en: An MSO that contravenes a specified provision with intent to defraud the Commissioner is liable on conviction on indictment to a $1,000,000 fine and seven years' imprisonment.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者出於詐騙關長的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。

coverage.point: 法院可在適當情況下收取違法者及罪行資料，決定有組織、三合會相關或其他嚴重罪行是否宜加重判刑。

snapshot.en: The OSCO lets Courts, where appropriate, receive offender and offence information to assess a greater sentence for organised, triad-related or other serious crimes.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》容許法院在適當情況下收取違法者及罪行資料，決定有組織／三合會相關或其他嚴重罪行應否加刑。

coverage.point: 諮詢議題包括偵測及防止錯誤支付及三種校正檢查選項，不是已生效的額外本地責任。

snapshot.en: The consultation seeks views on detecting and preventing misdirected payments, including use of the three alignment-check options foreseen in the revised Standard.
snapshot.tc: 諮詢的意見範圍涵蓋偵測及防止錯誤支付，包括善用修訂標準中預期的三種校正檢查選項。

coverage.point: 諮詢亦涵蓋落實建議16與資料保護及隱私要求的協調；原題直接測試，保留於替代題。

snapshot.en: The consultation invites views on whether the guidance sufficiently explains implementing Recommendation 16 while meeting data protection and privacy requirements.
snapshot.tc: 諮詢邀請各界就指引是否充分說明如何落實第16項建議，並同時符合資料保護及隱私要求，提出意見。

coverage.point: 獨資／合夥：商登及商業登記冊資料摘錄。

snapshot.en: For a sole proprietorship or partnership, the checklist includes copies of a valid Business Registration Certificate and an extract of information on the Business Register.
snapshot.tc: 就獨資經營或合夥申請人而言，清單包括有效商業登記證的複本，以及商業登記冊內資料的摘錄複本。

coverage.point: 本地與非香港公司：商登及不同公司證明書。

snapshot.en: For both a local company and a non-Hong Kong company applicant, the checklist specifies a Certificate of Incorporation alongside its valid Business Registration Certificate.
snapshot.tc: 就本地公司及非香港公司申請人而言，清單均要求提交公司註冊證明書的複本，以及有效商業登記證的複本。

coverage.point: 新本地公司法團成立表格依股份形式區分。

snapshot.en: For a newly established local company, the incorporation-form copy is Form NNC1 for a company limited by shares, or NNC1G for one not limited by shares.
snapshot.tc: 新成立的本地公司須提交法團成立表格的複本：股份有限公司使用表格NNC1，股份有限公司以外的公司使用表格NNC1G。

coverage.point: 新非香港公司NN1詳情文件。

snapshot.en: For a newly established non-Hong Kong company, the checklist includes a copy of Form NN1 giving particulars of the non-Hong Kong company registered in Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 新成立的非香港公司須提交表格NN1的複本，該表格載列在香港註冊的非香港公司詳情，屬清單指明的申請文件。

coverage.point: 非香港公司最近年報及之後存檔文件。

snapshot.en: A non-Hong Kong company applicant supplies its latest Annual Return, Form NN3, and copies of all documents filed with the Companies Registry after that annual return.
snapshot.tc: 非香港公司申請人須提交最近的周年申報表（表格NN3），以及遞交該申報表後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件的複本。

coverage.point: 兩類公司集團架構、各成員持股量、章程文件。

snapshot.en: Local and non-Hong Kong company applicants provide group structure and each member’s shareholding percentage, together with a copy of their Memorandum and Articles of Association.
snapshot.tc: 本地公司及非香港公司申請人均須提供集團架構、集團每一成員的持股量百分率，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。

coverage.point: 本地法團合夥人／董事完整文件組。

snapshot.en: For a local corporate partner or director, the documents include Form 3B and copies of a valid Business Registration Certificate, Certificate of Incorporation, and Memorandum and Articles of Association.
snapshot.tc: 法團合夥人或董事如屬本地公司，須遞交表格3B，以及有效商業登記證、公司註冊證明書、組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。

coverage.point: 非香港法團合夥人／董事完整文件組。

snapshot.en: For a non-Hong Kong corporate partner or director, the listed documents include Form 3B, a valid Business Registration Certificate, a Certificate of Registration of non-Hong Kong Company, and constitutional documents.
snapshot.tc: 法團合夥人或董事如屬非香港公司，須遞交表格3B、有效商業登記證、非香港公司註冊證明書，以及組織章程大綱及章程細則的複本。

coverage.point: 非在港註冊法團：3B及公司註冊證明書或核證等同文件。

snapshot.en: For a corporate partner or director not registered in Hong Kong, the checklist requires Form 3B and an incorporation-certificate copy or an equivalent document certified under the Companies (Forms) Regulations.
snapshot.tc: 非在香港註冊的法團合夥人或董事須交表格3B，另附公司註冊證明書複本或根據《公司（表格）規例》核證的等同文件複本。

coverage.point: 全部個人角色：3A兩附錄；香港／非香港居民的不同身份文件。

snapshot.en: Individual sole proprietors, partners, directors and ultimate owners provide Form 3A with both appendices, plus a Hong Kong Identity Card copy for residents or travel-document bio-data page copy for non-residents.
snapshot.tc: 獨資經營者、個人合夥人、董事及最終擁有人須交表格3A連附錄I及II；香港居民附身份證複本，非香港居民附旅遊證件個人資料頁複本。

coverage.point: LPS／LMO租約或業權、平面圖、准許相應用途的業主同意書。

snapshot.en: For both the LPS and LMO, the checklist includes a stamped tenancy-agreement or ownership-record copy, a floor plan, and a landlord-letter copy permitting the respective use of the premises.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點與本地管理辦事處均須附已加蓋釐印租約或業權紀錄複本、平面圖，以及業主准許作相應用途的同意書複本。

coverage.point: 業務計劃和政策的確認人完整範圍。

snapshot.en: Both the Business Plan and AML/CFT policy require endorsement by the applicable listed persons: the sole proprietor, each individual partner, director and ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，均須由清單所列適用人士確認：獨資經營者、每名個人合夥人、董事及最終擁有人。

coverage.point: CO／MLRO有效僱傭合約而非顧問合約。

snapshot.en: For the CO and MLRO, copies of valid contracts for external consultancy services satisfy the employment-contract document specified in the licence application checklist.
snapshot.tc: 就合規主任及洗錢報告主任而言，外部顧問服務合約的有效複本，已符合牌照申請清單所指定的僱傭合約文件要求。

coverage.point: CO／MLRO香港身份證。

snapshot.en: The checklist calls for copies of the CO’s and MLRO’s Hong Kong Identity Cards, in addition to the separately listed employment and residential-address documents.
snapshot.tc: 除另行列出的僱傭合約及住址證明文件外，牌照申請清單亦要求提交合規主任及洗錢報告主任的香港身份證複本。

coverage.point: 銀行簽發帳戶持有證明。

snapshot.en: The bank concerned issues the proof of bank account ownership, for example a copy of the statement for the applicant’s account used for the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 證明持有銀行帳戶的文件應由有關銀行發出，例如申請人持有並用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶結單複本。

coverage.point: 三類處所各自內外照片要求。

snapshot.en: Each operating premises, local storage place and local management office has a listed requirement for two 4R-sized photographs showing the premises’ exterior and interior.
snapshot.tc: 每一經營金錢服務處所、本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點及本地管理辦事處，均須提供兩張顯示外部及內部的4R照片。

coverage.point: 本地公司最近NAR1及遞交後存檔的全部文件。

snapshot.en: For a local company applicant, the latest Annual Return, Form NAR1, is accompanied by copies of all documents filed with the Companies Registry after that annual return.
snapshot.tc: 本地公司申請人須提交最近的周年申報表（表格NAR1），並附上遞交該申報表後存檔於公司註冊處的所有文件複本。

coverage.point: 資源須與運作性質及規模相稱。

snapshot.en: The assessment considers whether the person has financial resources adequate for the nature and scale of its operations, rather than assessing resources independently of the business.
snapshot.tc: 評估會考慮該人是否具備充分財政資源，支持其運作的性質及規模，而非脫離業務本身來評估資源是否足夠。

coverage.point: 財政狀況／償付能力不得損害客戶及公眾權益。

snapshot.en: Under the financial-integrity criterion, adequate operating resources make an adverse effect of the person’s solvency on customers and the public irrelevant to that criterion.
snapshot.tc: 在財政穩健準則下，只要該人具備足夠營運資源，其償付能力對客戶及公眾人士權益造成的不利影響便與該準則無關。

coverage.point: 未償還法院判決債項是財政穩健因素例子。

snapshot.en: Failure to satisfy a judgment debt under a court order is one example given for assessing a person’s financial integrity in the Supplementary Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 未能償還法庭命令的判決債項，是《補充指引》在評估某人的財政穩健程度時明確列出的其中一個例子。

coverage.point: 與債權人妥協／重整或還款安排。

snapshot.en: A compromise or arrangement made with creditors is another example relevant to financial integrity; the examples are not confined to unpaid court-ordered judgment debts.
snapshot.tc: 與債權人達成債務重整協議或債務償還安排，亦屬財政穩健準則所列的例子；例子不只限於未清償的判決債項。

coverage.point: 每項產品服務的類別及推出時間表。

snapshot.en: For the products and services to be offered, the plan should give their types and the timeline for launching them, so the proposed offering is accompanied by its rollout information.
snapshot.tc: 對於擬提供的產品及服務，業務計劃應說明其類別及推出時間表，使計劃載明提供甚麼產品及服務，以及何時推出。

coverage.point: 每個外地代理／MSO的訂單處理及資金流。

snapshot.en: The delivery-channel description should follow order processing and fund flows through each foreign agent or foreign MSO in different jurisdictions, covering the entire channel for each type of product or service.
snapshot.tc: 交付渠道的說明應涵蓋每類產品或服務的完整渠道，包括指令處理，以及資金如何經過不同司法管轄區的每個外地代理人或外地金錢服務經營者。

coverage.point: 管理團隊及僱員的完整人力資料。

snapshot.en: For both the management team and employees, the plan should describe numbers, positions, roles and responsibilities, full-time or part-time status, and reporting lines as part of the composition of those groups.
snapshot.tc: 就管理團隊及僱員兩類人員，計劃均須闡述人數、職位、角色及責任、全職或兼職，以及報告流程，作為各類人員組合的資料。

coverage.point: 申請人兼任代理人的對方名稱及職能。

snapshot.en: If the applicant also acts as agent for another local MSO or an overseas company or business entity, the plan should name the other party and elaborate the applicant’s functions as agent.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人同時為其他本地金錢服務經營者或海外公司／商業實體擔任代理人，計劃須列出對方名稱，並闡述申請人擔任代理人的職能。

coverage.point: 申請人兼任主事人的對方名稱及主事人職能。

snapshot.en: If the applicant also acts as principal for another local MSO or overseas business, the plan should name the other party and describe the applicant’s functions in that relationship as the agent.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人同時為其他本地金錢服務經營者或海外業務擔任主事人，計劃須列出對方名稱，並把申請人在該關係中的職能說明為代理人的職能。

coverage.point: 第三方平台／電子錢包的業務角色。

snapshot.en: Where the business uses a third party’s payment platform or network, such as a digital wallet, the plan should explain the role that the platform or network plays in the applicant’s business.
snapshot.tc: 如業務使用第三方支付平台或網絡，例如電子錢包，計劃須解釋該平台或網絡在申請人業務中所擔當的角色，作為業務關係資料。

coverage.point: 嘗試隱瞞；補救、處理涉事者及防再犯措施。

snapshot.en: In assessing conduct after a contravention, the CCE considers whether the MSO attempted to conceal it; the factor is not confined to successful concealment.
snapshot.tc: 評估金錢服務經營者作出違規行為後的表現時，關長會考慮其有否嘗試隱瞞違規行為；這項因素並不限於成功隱瞞的情況。

snapshot.en: After a contravention or possible contravention is identified, the CCE considers remedial steps, action against those involved, and steps to prevent similar breaches.
snapshot.tc: 發現違規或可能違規行為後，關長會考慮有關補救措施、對涉事人士採取的行動，以及為確保類似違規行為不再發生而採取的措施。

coverage.point: 其他有關機關就同一事件的懲罰及監管行動。

snapshot.en: For the same incident, the CCE takes account of other relevant authorities’ punishment and regulatory action, including action likely to be taken but not yet taken.
snapshot.tc: 就相同事件，關長會考慮其他有關當局施加的懲罰及監管行動，包括尚未採取但相當可能會採取的監管行動。

coverage.point: 過往類似違規，尤其曾因此被處分。

snapshot.en: When assessing compliance history, the CCE considers earlier similar contraventions by the MSO, particularly those for which it has already been disciplined.
snapshot.tc: 關長評估金錢服務經營者的合規情況時，相關過往紀律處分紀錄包括以前的類似違規行為，尤其是已因此遭紀律處分的行為。

coverage.point: 主要營業地點定義及與註冊辦事處地址可同或不同。

snapshot.en: A legal person’s principal place of business is where it primarily operates or carries on its main activities, and may be the same as or different from its registered office address.
snapshot.tc: 法人的主要營業地點是營運主要所在地或主要活動的地點，其地址可與註冊辦事處地址相同或不同。

coverage.point: 地址不符合業務性質或客戶狀況時須查明理據。

snapshot.en: If a legal person’s principal business address does not fit the MSO’s understanding of its business nature or customer profile, the MSO should seek the rationale for that address.
snapshot.tc: 如法人的主要營業地址不符合金錢服務經營者對其業務性質或客戶狀況的了解，經營者應致力找出獲提供該地址的理據。

coverage.point: LMO不可設於住宅／服務供應商地址；同題保留LPS平行要求。

snapshot.en: The CCE will not accept an MSO’s residential premises or its service provider’s premises, such as its accounting firm, as either its LPS or its LMO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的住宅或服務供應商處所（如會計事務所），均不獲關長接納為本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處。

coverage.point: LMO業主准許及租約／准許信形式；LPS相同。

snapshot.en: For both the LPS and LMO, the landlord’s permission to use the premises for money service business should appear in the tenancy agreement or a landlord’s letter.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點及本地管理辦事處的業主准許使用處所經營金錢服務，應載於租約或給申請人的准許信。

coverage.point: LMO／LPS所需資料缺失時申請無效，不予處理。

snapshot.en: A licence or renewal application missing required LPS information, or required LMO information where an LMO is needed, is deemed invalid and will not be processed by C&ED.

coverage.point: 打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策經指定適用人士確認 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: Both the Business Plan and AML/CFT policy require endorsement by the applicable listed persons: the sole proprietor, each individual partner, director and ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，均須由清單所列適用人士確認：獨資經營者、每名個人合夥人、董事及最終擁有人。

coverage.point: 參與服務的每一本地／外地第三方協議或合約複本。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: A copy of the agreement or contract with each local and/or foreign third party that is involved in the process of the money service
snapshot.tc: 與參與經營金錢服務的本地及／或外地第三方簽訂的協議／合約複本

coverage.point: CO及MLRO香港身份證複本。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: The checklist calls for copies of the CO’s and MLRO’s Hong Kong Identity Cards, in addition to the separately listed employment and residential-address documents.
snapshot.tc: 除另行列出的僱傭合約及住址證明文件外，牌照申請清單亦要求提交合規主任及洗錢報告主任的香港身份證複本。

coverage.point: CO及MLRO有效僱傭合約複本。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: For the CO and MLRO, copies of valid contracts for external consultancy services satisfy the employment-contract document specified in the licence application checklist.
snapshot.tc: 就合規主任及洗錢報告主任而言，外部顧問服務合約的有效複本，已符合牌照申請清單所指定的僱傭合約文件要求。

coverage.point: CO及MLRO住址證明複本及前三個月期限。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: For the CO and the MLRO, a copy of residential address proof, such as a utility bill or a bank statement, issued within the last six months from the application date
snapshot.tc: 合規主任及洗錢報告主任在申請日期前六個月內發出的住址證明（例如銀行結單）的複本

coverage.point: 銀行發出的帳戶持有證明，例為申請人業務帳戶結單。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: The bank concerned issues the proof of bank account ownership, for example a copy of the statement for the applicant’s account used for the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 證明持有銀行帳戶的文件應由有關銀行發出，例如申請人持有並用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶結單複本。

coverage.point: 銀行確認帳戶用作金錢服務業務。 [¶16.3 item 6]

snapshot.en: An acknowledgement from the bank that the bank account held by the applicant is used for operating the money service business
snapshot.tc: 確認由申請人持有的銀行帳戶是用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行確認書

coverage.point: 無特定處所適用、駐守、可到訪電話聯絡及失責後果。

snapshot.en: The licensees operating with or without particular premises must maintain a LMO
snapshot.tc: 無論持牌人會或不會在特定處所經營金錢服務，都須維持本地管理辦事處。

snapshot.en: LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處須駐有持牌人的合規主任、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。

snapshot.en: If an MSO licensee fails to maintain the LMO, it may result in the suspension and revocation of the MSO licence.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者持牌人未能維持本地管理辦事處，將可能會導致暫時吊銷及撤銷金錢服務經營者牌照。

coverage.point: 海外／本地代理失責時保護客戶資金。

snapshot.en: The measures taken to protect customer funds against loss if another agent or MSO, in or outside Hong Kong, fails to fulfil its part
snapshot.tc: 如其他在香港及香港以外的代理人或金錢服務經營者未能履行承諾，保障客戶資金免受損失的措施

coverage.point: 本地或跨境現金運送人士／公司名稱。

snapshot.en: Where the business involves physical cash movement, whether local or cross-boundary, the plan should name the company or person involved in those activities.
snapshot.tc: 業務如涉及本地或跨境的實體現金流動活動，業務計劃需提供參與這類活動的公司或人士的名稱或姓名。

coverage.point: 合作、再犯可能、過往承諾、利益／開支對象、主動通報及類案一致。

snapshot.en: A factor is the degree of cooperation with the CCE, other relevant authorities and/or law enforcement agencies during the investigation of the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 在調查違規行為期間與關長、其他有關當局及／或執法機構的合作程度，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: A factor is the likelihood that the contravener will commit the same type of contravention in the future if no penalty, or a lighter penalty, is imposed.
snapshot.tc: 如無施加罰款或施加較輕的罰款，違規者日後重犯同一類別違規行為的可能性，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: Among the factors on previous record and compliance history is whether the contravener had undertaken not to engage in the conduct that resulted in the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 在過往紀律處分紀錄及合規情況方面，違規者過往曾否承諾不會作出引致有關違規事件的行為，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: A factor is the amount of any benefit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention by the customers of the licensee or MSO.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人或金錢服務經營者的客戶從違規行為中所獲得的利益或所避免開支的數額，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: As a mitigating factor, the CCE considers whether the contravener has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to its attention.
snapshot.tc: 作為求情因素，關長會考慮違規者有否迅速、有效及完全地知會關長有關違規行為或可能違規行為。

snapshot.en: The CCE considers what action it and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases; in general, similar cases should be treated consistently.
snapshot.tc: 關長會考慮其本身及／或其他有關當局曾就過往的類似個案採取甚麽行動；相若的個案一般應以貫徹一致的方式處理。

coverage.point: 遵當時指引一般不紀律處分。

snapshot.en: The CCE generally takes no disciplinary action for conduct that was in line with the guidance current at the time of the conduct.
snapshot.tc: 如有關行為符合當時適用的導引，關長一般不會就該行為採取紀律行動。

coverage.point: 兑换部分排除汇款金额

snapshot.en: Part 1 contains money changing data and excludes amounts involved in remittance transactions.
snapshot.tc: 修訂定期申報表第1部只填報貨幣兌換相關數據，不包括匯款交易金額。

coverage.point: 外币金额由多至少

snapshot.en: The amounts of foreign currencies in the money changing part are entered in ascending order.
snapshot.tc: 修訂定期申報表的貨幣兌換部分，所填報的外幣金額須由少至多輸入。

coverage.point: 汇款金额由多至少

snapshot.en: In the remittance part of the revamped return, transaction amounts are entered in descending order.
snapshot.tc: 修訂定期申報表的匯款部分，所填報的匯款交易金額須由多至少輸入。

coverage.point: 交付渠道与客户类别比例各合计100%

snapshot.en: The relevant delivery-channel ratios and customer-type ratios for remittance transactions must each total 100%.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易所用交付渠道及服務客戶種類的相關比例，各自的總額必須為100%。

coverage.point: 新增资料的监管目的

snapshot.en: The extra data helps track industry trends and formulate effective and appropriate regulatory measures.
snapshot.tc: 新增資料有助緊貼金錢服務業的最新趨勢，並制定有效和適當的業務規管措施。

coverage.point: 两类业务的CDD、EDD及拒绝交易数量

snapshot.en: Both the money changing and remittance parts record the numbers of CDD conducted, EDD conducted and rejected transactions or cases.
snapshot.tc: 貨幣兌換及匯款部分均記錄執行盡職審查、執行更嚴格的盡職審查及拒絕交易或個案的數目。

coverage.point: 向JFIU报告的可疑交易数量

snapshot.en: The transaction monitoring part records how many suspicious transactions the company has reported to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 修訂定期申報表的交易監察部分，須填報公司向聯合財富情報組報告的可疑交易數目。

coverage.point: 公司接获的执法文书数量

snapshot.en: The law enforcement request field counts letters of no consent, restraint orders or confiscation orders issued by the company.
snapshot.tc: 執法機構要求欄位計算由公司發出的不同意通知書、限制令或沒收令數目。

coverage.point: 提交日香港金钱服务业务的估计资产总值（港元）

snapshot.en: The asset field asks for the estimated total assets of the company's money service business in Hong Kong as of the return's submission date, in HKD.
snapshot.tc: 資產欄位要求以港元填報公司在香港經營金錢服務業務截至申報表提交日期的估算資產總額。

specialist_coverage.point: OSCO容許法院在適當情況下收取違法者及罪行資料，以判斷有組織、三合會相關或其他嚴重罪行是否宜加重判刑；與B41同一缺口合併補足。

snapshot.en: The OSCO lets Courts, where appropriate, receive offender and offence information to assess a greater sentence for organised, triad-related or other serious crimes.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》容許法院在適當情況下收取違法者及罪行資料，決定有組織／三合會相關或其他嚴重罪行應否加刑。

specialist_coverage.point: 支付透明度諮詢涵蓋落實建議16與資料保護／隱私要求的協調；原m1-177#5已直接覆蓋，原文保留於新替代題，不重複另寫。

snapshot.en: The consultation invites views on whether the guidance sufficiently explains implementing Recommendation 16 while meeting data protection and privacy requirements.
snapshot.tc: 諮詢邀請各界就指引是否充分說明如何落實第16項建議，並同時符合資料保護及隱私要求，提出意見。

specialist_coverage.point: 業主／租戶經常控制的特定處所例子。

snapshot.en: Premises regularly controlled by the licensee as a landlord or tenant are another example of particular premises identified in the Guide.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人以業主或租戶身分經常控制的處所，是指引所列用以經營金錢服務業務的另一個特定處所例子。

specialist_coverage.point: 無固定處所的上門服務例子。

snapshot.en: A door-to-door money service without any fixed premises is an example the Guide does not treat as operation at particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 在沒有固定處所的情況下提供上門金錢服務，是指引不視為在特定處所經營金錢服務的例子之一。

specialist_coverage.point: 流動電子設備例子，依E13各語言原文。

snapshot.en: Conducting transactions with mobile electronic devices is listed by the Guide among its examples of operating a money service without particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 只使用流動電子設備進行交易，屬指引所列不視為在特定處所經營金錢服務業務的其中一個例子。

specialist_coverage.point: 銀行簽發帳戶持有證明。

snapshot.en: The bank concerned issues the proof of bank account ownership, for example a copy of the statement for the applicant’s account used for the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 證明持有銀行帳戶的文件應由有關銀行發出，例如申請人持有並用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶結單複本。

specialist_coverage.point: 應考合資格人士對公司合規職能及制度負責。

snapshot.en: An eligible person nominated for the Assessment is held accountable for the company’s compliance functions and systems, alongside the other requirements for that person’s senior-management role.
snapshot.tc: 獲提名應考的合資格人士，除須符合有關高級管理層角色的其他條件外，亦須對公司的合規職能及制度負責。

snapshot.en: Once the answer script and related materials have been collected, a candidate may leave the Assessment centre without obtaining the invigilator’s permission for departure.
snapshot.tc: 答卷及相關物品一經收回，應考者便可離開試場，無須另行取得監考員就其離場所給予的准許。

specialist_coverage.point: 提早離場須確認答卷及物品已收回。

snapshot.en: A candidate leaving early must make sure that the invigilator has collected the answer script and related materials on the spot before the candidate departs.
snapshot.tc: 如應考者提早離開，必須在離場前確保監考員已即場收回答卷及相關物品，不能把物品留下而未確認收回。

specialist_coverage.point: 主考員指示填寫答題紙資料。

snapshot.en: Before answering the questions, candidates must follow the Presiding Invigilator’s instructions to enter the required particulars on the multiple-choice answer sheet provided for the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 作答前，應考者須根據主考員的指示，在能力評核提供的選擇題答題紙上填寫所要求的資料。

specialist_coverage.point: 覆檢書面要求的接收單位。

snapshot.en: A candidate seeking re-checking of an Assessment result may address the written request to the Licensing Control Division, subject to the time limit specified in the Guidance Notes.
snapshot.tc: 應考者如要求覆檢能力評核成績，可在《須知》所指定的期限內，以書面致函牌照管制課提出要求。

specialist_coverage.point: 換錢黨為向個人及實體非法提供大額兌換的非法團體。

snapshot.en: The term describes illicit groups unlawfully providing large-amount currency exchange services to individuals and entities, rather than treating every currency exchange business as such a group.
snapshot.tc: 該用語描述非法向個人及實體提供大額貨幣兌換服務的非法團體，並非把每個經營貨幣兌換的業務都視為這類團體。

specialist_coverage.point: 高利貸服務對象為澳門賭客。

snapshot.en: The loan activity specified in the circular’s description is the provision of high-interest loans to money service operators in Macao, alongside the groups’ unlawful currency exchange services.
snapshot.tc: 通函描述指明的放貸活動，是在非法貨幣兌換服務以外，向澳門的金錢服務經營者提供高利貸服務。

specialist_coverage.point: 規避內地外幣兌換管制及非法兌換大額港幣現金的目的。

snapshot.en: The groups seek to circumvent the Mainland’s foreign exchange controls by illegally exchanging substantial amounts of Hong Kong dollars in cash for gamblers, as described in the circular.
snapshot.tc: 按通函所述，該等團體旨在透過非法為賭客兌換大額港幣現金，繞過內地有關外幣兌換管制措施的規例。

specialist_coverage.point: 規避內地海外扣帳卡提款限額。

snapshot.en: The card-withdrawal restriction these groups seek to circumvent is the Mainland’s overseas credit-card withdrawal limit, alongside the foreign exchange controls identified in the circular’s description of their activities.
snapshot.tc: 該等團體旨在繞過的提款限制，是內地有關海外信用卡提款限額的規例，並同時繞過通函描述所指的外幣兌換管制措施。

snapshot.en: The extra data helps track industry trends and formulate effective and appropriate regulatory measures.
snapshot.tc: 新增資料有助緊貼金錢服務業的最新趨勢，並制定有效和適當的業務規管措施。

# Official source documents

[繁體中文版 →](README.zh-Hant.md)

The 23 documents the question bank and the revision pack are written from, in
English (`EN/`) and Traditional Chinese (`TC/`). The same number denotes the
same document in both languages. All were downloaded from the official sources
listed below (the C&ED Money Service Operators Licensing System portal, and Hong
Kong e-Legislation for the Ordinance), and were checked as a full set against the portal
on 24 September 2026 (the Ordinance on 28 September 2026).

On 17 October 2026, the EN and TC PDFs for 02–09 and 19–21 were
re-downloaded and matched the archives byte for byte; substantive FAQ passages
also matched the official page. Other documents retain their original check
dates. The current Ordinance page was blocked by a client-configuration check,
so this update continues to use the archived consolidated text above.

Documents 01–09 are the Guidance Notes and the guidelines, 10 is the
Ordinance, 11–21 are the circulars still in force, oldest first, 22 is the FAQ
page and 23 is the official sample paper. The Guidance Notes ¶6.1 name five
reference sources for the assessment and item (5) is "Circulars issued by C&ED
to MSOs", so the circulars are examinable.

Only current documents belong here: a circular whose content a later official
document now covers is superseded, and is removed. The FATF-statement circulars
replace one another after each FATF plenary, so only the latest, 20, is kept.
The UN-sanctions notices are left out: each announces one change to a sanctions
list, and the examinable rules on screening are in 02 ch. 6. The numbers 01–23
date from 24 September 2026; earlier commits number the documents differently.

| # | Document (`EN/`) | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment | Dec 2022 | MSOS portal, licensing downloads |
| 02 | Guideline on AML/CFT for Money Service Operators | Jun 2023 | MSOS portal, guidelines |
| 03 | Licensing Guide | May 2026 | MSOS portal, guidelines |

| 11 | Circular: Cross-boundary Movement of Currency Ordinance, Cap. 629 (MSSB/MIS_06/2018) | 31 Jul 2018 | MSOS portal, circulars |
| 12 | Circular: ML/TF Risks of Delivery Channels (MSSB/MIS_05/2021) | 13 Dec 2021 | MSOS portal, circulars |
| 13 | Circular: Supervisory Findings on Customer Due Diligence (MSSB/MIS_03/2023) | 22 Nov 2023 | MSOS portal, circulars |
| 14 | Circular: ML/TF Risks of Third Party Payments (MSSB/MIS_01/2024) | 17 Sep 2024 | MSOS portal, circulars |

| 17 | Circular: E-form Submission for Passenger Information (Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments) (MSSB/MIS_03/2025) | 23 Jun 2025 | MSOS portal, circulars |

The Traditional Chinese editions in `TC/` carry the same numbers.

`text/` holds the text of every document in both languages, extracted by
[`extract_text.py`](extract_text.py). `quotes.json` holds, for every statement in
the bank and each language, the passage of a cited document that decides its
truth, copied word for word from that text. The tests check each quote against
the text, and the text against the documents here, so after adding or replacing
a document run `python docs/extract_text.py` (it needs PyMuPDF).

## Which documents each module is examined from

Guidance Notes ¶5.2 name the seven modules; ¶6.1 names five categories of
reference material, but neither says which category feeds which module. The
mapping below is derived from the bank itself — every citation in
[`web/questions.json`](../web/questions.json) resolved to the document it names,
by the numbers used in the table above. A question may cite two documents, so
the per-document figures can sum above the module total.

|---|---|---|
| **1** General knowledge on AML/CFT and counter-proliferation financing | **01** (1) · **02** (23) · **10** (2) · **11** (2) · **14** (1) · **15** (1) · **17** (1) · **18** (1) · **19** (2) · **20** (2) · **21** (1) · **22** (1) | 31 |
| **2** Parts 1–7 of the AMLO | **10** (50) · **22** (1) · **23** (1) | 50 |
| **3** Schedules to the AMLO | **02** (2) · **10** (42) · **23** (1) | 42 |
| **4** Guidelines promulgated by the C&ED | **01** (9) · **03** (25) · **04** (1) · **05** (4) · **06** (4) · **07** (4) · **08** (4) · **09** (5) · **10** (2) · **16** (1) · **22** (1) · **23** (1) | 50 |
| **5** Systems and controls (i): institutional governance and strategy | **02** (55) · **07** (1) · **10** (1) · **12** (1) · **23** (1) | 56 |
| **6** Systems and controls (ii): AML/CFT control areas | **02** (58) · **10** (5) · **12** (1) · **13** (5) · **14** (6) · **22** (24) · **23** (1) | 69 |
| **7** Systems and controls (iii): demonstrating and monitoring compliance | **02** (40) · **22** (1) · **23** (2) | 40 |

The current bank includes all seven samples from **23**, plus the sample in
**01** ¶7.1. **22**, the FAQ, is cited by 28 questions: 1 in module 1, 1 in module 2, 1 in module 4, 24 in module 6, 1 in module 7. The figures above describe the active bank, excluding
retired questions preserved in Git history.

Two of these are worth singling out. **23** is the only set of sample questions
C&ED has ever published, and it settles what the paper looks like: seven items,
each a stem with four numbered statements and the five fixed options `a) 1, 2
and 3 b) 1, 2 and 4 c) 2, 3 and 4 d) 1, 3 and 4 e) All of the above`. Guidance
Notes ¶7.1 carries an eighth in the same family, with five statements and a
different fixed block. **22** is not a PDF: the FAQ exists only as a page on the
portal, so the page itself is archived as Markdown. It holds two series — “FAQ
applicable to all Money Service Operators”, 28 questions on the AML/CFT
Guideline, each answer closing with a Key Reference naming the paragraph it
elaborates, and “FAQ in Application for an MSO Licence”, 15 on licence
application, which carry no such reference. Both series serve as question material; the licensing FAQ also supports
questions on exemptions, related persons and procedural roles.

Live pages to re-check for newer editions, for the next FATF statement (which
replaces 20), and for the UN-sanctions notices (deliberately not archived here):

- FAQs: <https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/common/faqs>
- Guidelines: <https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/common/guidelines>
- Circulars: <https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/common/circulars>
- The Ordinance: <https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap615>

These documents are publications of the Government of the Hong Kong Special
Administrative Region and are reproduced here for study reference only.

They are **not covered by the licences that apply to the rest of this

above.

Circular 
 
Circular to Money Service Operators 
 
Electronic Submission of Periodic Return for Statement of Transactions 
via Money Service Operators Licensing System 
 
In accordance with the Money Service Operators (“MSOs”) Licensing Guide, MSOs are 
required to submit periodic returns (“PRs”) to the Commissioner of Customs and Excise 
(“CCE”) in the form specified by the CCE in a timely manner.  Any failure to submit a 
PR on time may result in the suspension and/or revocation of the licence.  Under the 
existing mechanism, a PR is lodged quarterly based on the start date of the MSO licence, 
i.e. 4 submissions per year. 
 
With a view to allowing sufficient time for MSO licensees to prepare accurate 
information and facilitating the submission process, the Customs and Excise Department 
(“C&ED”) will adjust the lodgement arrangement for PRs with effect from 30 June 2025. 
 
The new lodgement arrangement is on a half-yearly basis, i.e. 2 submissions per year, 
in which the first return covers the transaction information from 1 January to 30 June of 
the respective year and the second return covers those from 1 July to 31 December.  For 
the purpose of staying abreast of the latest trend in the money service industry and 
formulating effective and appropriate regulatory measures for the money service 
business, the CCE also requires MSOs to provide additional information in the new PR 
including: 
 
⚫ 
foreign currencies involved in money changing transactions; 
⚫ 
jurisdictions involved in remittance transactions; and 
⚫ 
delivery channels used in remittance transactions. 
 
An Annex is appended for illustrating the data required in the new PR. 
 
With the new lodgement arrangement in place, all MSO licensees are required to lodge 
their first new PR, covering the transactions from 1 January 2025 to 30 June 2025, 
beginning from 1 July 2025. 
 
 In addition, to further promote electronic services for various applications and 
submissions in relation to MSO licences, MSO licensees are required to submit new PRs 
via the electronic service of the Money Service Operators Licensing System (“MSOS”).  
The C&ED will no longer accept PR submission in paper form.  In this connection, 
MSO licensees are reminded to create a user account on MSOS in advance.  For more 
information on the creation of accounts, please refer to the MSOS website at 
https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/wnr/001s0. 
 
Should you have any enquiries or need any assistance regarding the transition to the new 
PR practice, please email us at mso_feedback@customs.gov.hk or call us at 3742 7787.
